independent_claim_checks.claim: PIC completes £85m buy-in for Interface Europe Pension Scheme
independent_claim_checks.source_excerpt: Pension Insurance Corporation plc (PIC), a specialist insurer of defined benefit pension schemes, has concluded an £85 million buy-in with the Trustee of the Interface Europe Pension Scheme. This agreement ensures the long-term protection of benefits for f 1,117 scheme members. Dalriada Trustees Limited serves as the sole professional trustee for the Scheme. Interface, a global commercial flooring manufacturer with sales spanning every continent, supplies an integrated product range that includes resilient flooring and carpet tiles.
